# Land Tenure

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:LandTenure`](gmeow-LandTenure.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/LandTenure>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

The reified, time-scoped fact that a party holds rights over a place — ownership, lease, easement, mortgage, usufruct, or another property right. Bridges the locations module to the rights module by referencing [`RightsStatement`](gmeow-RightsStatement.md). Distinct from [`JurisdictionTenure`](gmeow-JurisdictionTenure.md) (governance/sovereignty) and [`RegulatoryOverlay`](gmeow-RegulatoryOverlay.md) (regulation): [`LandTenure`](gmeow-LandTenure.md) is about property rights. Contested titles coexist as multiple standpoint-indexed instances, never collapsing to a single winner ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:TimeScopedRelation`](gmeow-TimeScopedRelation.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:LandTenure`](gmeow-LandTenure.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:TimeScopedRelation`](gmeow-TimeScopedRelation.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
